name: Mycorrhizal fungi
description: Fungi living in symbiosis with grass roots, obtaining their carbon from the living plant (and delivering mineral nutrients in return - the nutrient-delivery arrow shown in the source figure is not a feeding link and is omitted). Functional group aggregating all mycorrhizal fungi, measured as one pool by the source. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
